verdicts.reason: A reflows the headline into four large lines that fill the square well, but the CTA and LIMITED badge are pushed into a cramped bottom strip, the badge is split off to the right and swapped to the other side of the button, and neither lines up with the centred headline. B is the original at its old size, placed in the middle of the square with no rearranging: large empty orange areas above and below, a headline and CTA that look small for the canvas, and a tiny LIMITED badge that is hard to read.
